paper_metadata.title: Accelerated design of novel W-free high-strength Co-base superalloys with extremely wide γ/γʹ region by machine learning and CALPHAD methods

evidence.quote: we successfully design novel W-free Co-V-Ta-base alloys by employing machine learning algorithm and CALPHAD methods
